lines.l: Lover, don't you leave me, why would you go I'm on my knees, baby, begging you, no
Why would you do that, baby?
Why would you do that to me?
Why would you do that, baby?
Why would you do that to me?
And all the little lies you tell yourself
That we could just be friends
But you don't, so you won't
Why would I, why would I, why would I try
